card.name: Second digit of a year
card.fires_on: The digit after the leading 1 in a four-digit year such as 1852 or 1952, in history passages. It also fires on the space before a year.

modes.label: Second digit of year
modes.description: The 8 or 9 after the 1 in a year from the 1800s or 1900s, usually after 'in'.

modes.label: Space before a year
modes.description: The space just before a year is written.
modes.example: it was established in<< >>1952 by Pierre Plantard

card.plain: It marks the century digit when a year like 1852 or 1951 is being written in a history text.
